rule.description: **检查点**: 教程中提供的启动命令和参数（如 max-model-len、rope-scaling）必须在对应版本上实际运行验证

antipattern.code:
Run performance evaluation of `wen3-235B-A22B-w8a8` as an example.
<!-- gemini-bot: 应为 Qwen3-235B-A22B-w8a8，缺少首字母 Q -->

vllm bench serve --model vllm-ascend/wen3-235B-A22B-w8a8 \
    --dataset-name random --random-input 200 --num-prompt 200 \
    --request-rate 1 --save-result --result-dir ./
<!-- gemini-bot: 模型名拼写错误，命令会失败 -->

python -m vllm.entrypoints.openai.api_server \
    --compilation-config '{"cudagraph_capture_sizes":[1,4,8],"cudagraph_mode":"FULL_DECODE_ONLY"}' \
    --max-num-seqs 4
<!-- gemini-bot: capture_sizes 含 8 但 max-num-seqs=4，batch=8 不可能 -->

    --max-model-len 133000
<!-- leo-pony: 超过模型限制 131072，会报 ValidationError -->

    --rope-scaling '{"rope_type":"yarn","factor":4,"original_max_position_embeddings":32768}'
<!-- leo-pony: 最新版中 --rope-scaling 参数不可用，会报 unrecognized arguments -->

pattern.code:
Run performance evaluation of `Qwen3-235B-A22B-w8a8` as an example.

vllm bench serve --model vllm-ascend/Qwen3-235B-A22B-w8a8 \
    --dataset-name random --random-input 200 --num-prompt 200 \
    --request-rate 1 --save-result --result-dir ./

python -m vllm.entrypoints.openai.api_server \
    --compilation-config '{"cudagraph_capture_sizes":[1,4],"cudagraph_mode":"FULL_DECODE_ONLY"}' \
    --max-num-seqs 4

    --max-model-len 131072

    --hf-overrides '{"rope_parameters": {"rope_type":"yarn","rope_theta":1000,"factor":4,"original_max_position_embeddings":32768}}'
